limitations: Debug profile only; no release-profile or installed-layout performance claim.
Thirty fresh process exits per arm after equal image warmups against an already running disposable owned daemon.
Timing includes owned-process setup, complete output collection and clean exit; fixture/reset/preparation/state checks and independent endpoint probes are outside timer.
p50/p95 floors are observed identical-input repeat-block quantile ranges, not confidence intervals; desktop/WSL ambient load remains uncontrolled.
Original Python/tests/oracle bytes remain unchanged; original lease nodes are not Rust-routed by this proof.
Successful-run timing is not admitted or claimed.
hold/break/delegate/designate remain explicitly deferred; complete CLI-LEASE and final acceptance are not claimed.
